utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, you heard about the repair drive too? I can tell you who’s coordinating it and which houses still need help.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Sure, but can you confirm who’s organizing it?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: It’s Mara and Ben from the block watch, and Mara’s the one keeping the list. I can tell you which houses still need a hand too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I can help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks. I might need a second if I miss something.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure, I can help with that if you miss anything.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can take a look at it later today. What part needs fixing first?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: The front cabinet door keeps sticking, and the hinge on the hallway light is loose.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll start with the cabinet door, then I’ll tighten the hallway light hinge after.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with that if you point me to the part that still needs work.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll grab the missing part and point you to it.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Perfect, I’ll head over once you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after the school run if you can swing by later.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s brilliant, thanks Faye. I’ll swing by after the school run and bring what I can.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Brilliant, see you then. I’ll have the kettle on when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive, with the timing and who’s handling what.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure — I’ll put together the timing and handoff list and bring it by shortly.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, Pia — I’m spreading the word now, and I’ll tell everyone to come by for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Could you make sure there’s room for everyone and that the tools will be organized?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll make sure there’s enough space and keep the tools organized for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I only heard bits about it. Is the repair drive the one everyone’s helping with today?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Yes, that’s the one. We’re gathering neighbors’ help on repairs today, and I can point you to the table if you’d like.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, where’s the table?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Before I head out, can you confirm which materials and which street corner the repair drive is using?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: It’s the usual repair kit: gloves, zip ties, tape, and a box of basic tools. We’re set up at the corner by Maple and 3rd.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it, Maple and 3rd, with gloves, zip ties, tape, and basic tools.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the drive, but I may need a little time on my end.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: No rush, I can still swing by later and help once you’re free.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That works, thanks. I’ll let you know when I’m free.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring over my drill and a few screwdrivers if that helps with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: That would help a lot. Can you bring them by this afternoon?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, I can bring them by this afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ve got the repair drive on my list. Where are you headed with it?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just taking it over to the shop down the street. I’ll keep you posted.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it. I’ll note the shop down the street and keep an eye out for your update.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I can bring what I’ve got by after lunch and help get the drive squared away.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll be there after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Appreciate it. I’ll bring the tools and see you after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but we should make sure the schedule and parts list are settled before anyone starts driving around.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm the schedule and parts list are actually set, or are we still waiting on those?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on a confirmed schedule and parts list, so I wouldn’t send anyone out yet.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, I can use a couple extra hands on the bigger fixes and cleanup.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely, I can help with the bigger fixes and cleanup. Point me at the first area you want tackled.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies; tell me what the repair drive still needs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a little late, but I can take a look at the list and fill whatever’s still missing.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, then let’s start with the missing list and I’ll mark off anything you can bring.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that repair drive? I heard they’re still looking for a few more hands this afternoon. I can ask around and see who’s free.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’ll poke around and see if anyone can lend a hand after lunch.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great, thank you. I’ll get the repair drive list organized and send you the details.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Great, send it over when you can.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Leo. What do you need me to bring or fix?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can bring a drill and a couple screwdrivers. If you tell me what’s loose, I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, I’ll check what’s loose and let you know what to fix first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I heard the repair drive is getting started, and I can spread the word fast if you want more hands there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that would help a lot. What do you need most at the drive?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Mostly we need volunteers who can lift and sort donations, plus a few people to greet arrivals and keep things moving.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can check the repair drive location if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Please check it, and let me know the location.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the repair drive location and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What exactly needs fixing for the repair drive, and when do you need it done?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to check the exact items and the deadline before I say yes, so we can be precise about what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Can you list the exact repairs and the deadline so I know whether I can commit?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re organizing the repair drive now. I can swing by after errands and bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Great, I’m on it too. I just need to remember where I left my gloves first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: If you find them, I can help carry the heavier stuff when I get back.
